text: Kaa ko hommbo jaabinanta on mo fiyaake muuɗum ɓitti haa satti si o torike Mo, O ittata ko yanata e hoore neɗɗo on immorde e ñaw e baasal e tanaa majji, O waɗa on lontiiɓe ka leydi yoga e mooɗon lontoo yoga yirde ɓaawo yirde. Ko reweteeɗo goo woni waɗude ɗum wonndude e Alla?! Oo'ooye, fanɗii ko waajitotoɗon taskoɗon.
